# Construct output: preserve TL motif; place scaled/reflected motif around each 2-core in other quadrants.
grid=[[4]*27 for _ in range(27)]
for i in range(27): grid[13][i]=1; grid[i][13]=1
# template source pixels from test TL rows 3-6
src={(3,6):7,(4,5):8,(4,6):7}
for r in (5,6):
    src[(r,4)]=9
    for c in (5,6): src[(r,c)]=2
    for c in (7,8): src[(r,c)]=1
# copy TL exactly
for (r,c),v in src.items(): grid[r][c]=v

def place(anchor_r,anchor_c,s,flip_r=False,flip_c=False):
    # expand each source cell into sxs, relative to top-left of source 2x2 core
    for (r,c),v in src.items():
        if v==2: continue
        rr=r-5; cc=c-5
        r0=(1-rr)*s if flip_r else rr*s
        c0=(1-cc)*s if flip_c else cc*s
        for dr in range(s):
            for dc in range(s):
                R=anchor_r+r0+dr; C=anchor_c+c0+dc
                if 0<=R<27 and 0<=C<27 and R!=13 and C!=13:
                    grid[R][C]=v
# marker quadrants: top-right at 5,20; bottom-left 19,4; bottom-right 20,19
place(5,20,1,False,True)
place(19,4,2,True,False)
place(20,19,1,True,True)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
